home-content2:
This website was created to bring a little preview of what is being prepared for the celebration. Here, you’ll be able to discover the venue, get a taste of the food and drinks that will be served, learn a little more about how the celebration will unfold, receive updates as the date approaches and above all, confirm your presence.

Are you curious about the teasers and the catchphrases in the postcards you received?
party-header-center: The Party: What | When | Where | How
party-schedule:
What: Marcos's 60th birthday
When: Sunday, July 18th, 2027 at 12:00 PM.
Where: São Paulo, Brazil.
How: read on
party-content1: You have so far received these two postcards with the catchphrases "On my 60th, you get 67" or "That is 60 + 7" or "You will be the star".
party-content2:
Be no more. The usage of the numbers 67 or 6-7 is obviously in reference to the meme that is a viral Internet joke that is going around and very popular among Gen Alpha kids. The ironic thing is it has no real logical meaning. While the trend is nonsensical, 67 is coincidently the year I was born.

The party will last 6-7 hours (that isn't a joke) but don’t worry, you won’t starve since there will be lots of food and drinks served thoughout the day.

Most importantly, you won't get bored either because there will be lots of fun. In fact, guess who will be providing the entertainment?

🫵 🫵  YOU ARE!  🫵 🫵

Yes, you are providing the entertainment... because...

star-content1:
I wanted this party to be a little different. No DJ. No professional band. No hired singers. And definitely no 20-minute retrospective video of my life while everyone politely watches me grow older in chronological order. Instead, I had a thought:

Why can’t we be the entertainment?

The second postcard practically revealed how it works.
star-content2:
But what does that mean? It means 60 seconds and 7 songs. You give me 60 seconds, I give you 7 songs.

The 60 seconds - Explained

I would love some of my family and friends to choose something from the last 60 years — a song, a singer, a band, a movie, a play, a musical, a television moment, or anything else that brings back an era — and take the stage for just 60 seconds.

That's it. One minute for you to shine.
star-content3:
Sing karaoke. Lip-sync Madonna. Play something on an instrument. Sing a cappella. Recreate a movie scene. Do a silly dance from the ’70s. Grab two or three friends and do something together. Be elegant. Be daring. Be dramatic. Be funny. Be completely outrageous.

There are no rules about talent — because this is not a talent show.

There will be no judges. No prizes. No scores. And absolutely no expectation that anything should look or sound professional. In fact, perfection would probably ruin it.

Could it be tacky? Of course. Some people would argue that entire decades of the last 60 years were tacky. Could it be cheesy? Absolutely.

Who decided cheesy was a bad thing?

The only thing it should never be is intimidating. Nobody is being asked to prove anything. Nobody needs to know how to sing, dance or act. You don't even have to do it alone. Find a partner, recruit a group, hide behind sunglasses, wear a wig, hold a microphone that isn't turned on — whatever gets you onto that stage. Because the point isn't the performance.

The point is that we did it together.

Years from now, I doubt anyone will remember whether somebody sang perfectly. But we will remember the uncle who thought he was Elvis, the friend who became Madonna, the cousins who recreated a movie scene, and the person nobody expected to get on stage who suddenly stole the evening. That's the kind of retrospective I want.

I want us to create the next memory together, instead of dwell in the last 6 decades.

That is the best present you could give me.

Remember, there will be several of us doing that. You are not alone in this. Choose your moment. Choose your decade. Choose your accomplices. Bring the fun.

I’ll provide the stage, the music and the lights. And while we are talking about music, here's the other part of the 67.

The 7 songs - Explained

This is even simpler. How many times have you gone to a party and wished the DJ played that one song you love. You may have even asked the DJ to play a song and he might not have. In our party (yes, ours) that won't happen. You simply choose 7 songs of the last 60 years and I will have them played once the dancefloor is opened.

rsvp-content1:
You have received the birthday postcards because you are important to us and have been part of our lives and story. It would mean a great deal to share this special moment with you. We understand the party is still months away and we know how difficult it is to commit to something this far ahead, since plans and circumstances can change unexpectedly.

Since this is a sit-down celebration, we must confirm and pay in advance for each guest added to the guestlist. For that reason, we decided to finalize the guestlist in two steps.

Step 1 launched with the creation of a temporary list that will give us an idea of how many people will be attending and the scope of what we need to organize and how.

Those answering "Yes" now will be entered in the temporary guestlist.

Step 2 will happen closer to the day of the party. We will create the final guestlist and send a final postcard asking the ones in the temporary list to provide their definite confirmation.
rsvp-content2:
Nobody is under the obligation to attend. In fact, "No" is absolutely understandable and perfectly acceptable. It is much better than a "Yes" that turns into an absent guest who gave no prior notice of the no-show. It is very frustrating when someone confirms their presence then does not show up and it leads to two unpleasant and inconvenient situations:

  • A no-show guest leaves an empty seat, and an empty seat means a meal that was wasted.
  • A no-show guest also takes away the opportunity from another guest who could otherwise have attended.

Therefore this temporary guestlist will remain available until the final list closes a few days before the party. At any point from now, if you are or anyone in your group is unable to attend, feel free to come back here and adjust your response.

Thank you for considering the time, care, and expenses that will go into organizing this celebration. Above all, we hope that everyone who joins us will be there because they too genuinely want to share and celebrate this special moment with us.
